items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: George Kirby, it happened to him. I had to tell him to leave the white woman and he might get some work.

ctx.x: George Kirby, it happened to him. I had to tell him to leave the white woman and he might get some work. He

finally did and he got some work, then he went back to the girl again and then he got messing up with the dope, then they got him because the white girl gave him away. She stooled on him. But the girl that he was with before, he bought her a home in Chicago. She got a home in Chicago and she put up her home and put up a bond for him, the white girl in Chicago did.
